adjudications.rationale: docs/MAP.md:111 (at 4eaa58f) defines `runs` as requiring the deployable to name an image that matches the target component's declared image identity.  The label's why cites only that the image repository path ends in 'changedetection.io', which is the package name (setup.py:43).  That is a name-similarity inference, not a declared image identity for the local component.  The compose service uses a pre-built external image from GHCR (docker-compose.yml:3); the component source contains no explicit declaration of a registry image path (the Dockerfile OCI labels at Dockerfile:83 give a human-readable title, not a registry-path identity).  The MAP.md definition is not satisfied by name similarity alone.
